proposals.evidence: Turner gives Prakrit juṇṇa, Gujarati jūnũ and Marathi junā under jūrṇa old. These unextended western zūn-/dzun- survey forms match that regional palatal/affricate series and agreement vowels. The short-i jīrṇa branch and l/ḍl-extended responses are not conflated with it.

proposals.evidence: Turner explicitly lists Assamese/Bengali dhala/dhalā, Punjabi dhaulā and Gujarati dhɔḷũ white under dhavala. These survey dola/doḷo/doḷā forms fit that contracted l-bearing white family, preserving absent aspiration in the source. Forms without l/r require comparison with the separate dhava stem and are excluded.
